chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

q1_what_did_you_play: I used Shinobu - Warding Ring's damage mode, dealing 3 to all enemies and defeating both Leaf Slimes, then played All Streams Flow to the Sea on Twig Slime (S), leaving it at 4 HP after Block.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered playing Water's Edge and All Streams Flow to the Sea into the two Leaf Slimes, but that would leave Twig Slime (S) untouched behind its Block.
q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up the 4 Block mode of Shinobu - Warding Ring and left Twig Slime (S) alive to deal its telegraphed 4 damage.
q4_different_intent: Yes. A sufficiently large attack telegraph, especially one threatening lethal at 16 HP, could have made the 4 Block mode preferable despite giving up the two Leaf Slime defeats.
